0 表示不限。仅累计首次活动实际发放的正向经验；扣回不恢复额度，剩余额度不足时只: 0 means unlimited. Only actual positive first rewards consume capacity. Reversals do not restore it; a partial allowance issues only the remainder, without later top-ups. Manual awards and original-amount compensation are exempt.
0 表示只授予荣誉。修改奖励会建立新版本，已有成就不补发奖励。: 0 grants an honor only. Changing XP creates a new version and never tops up existing achievements.
<p>WP XP Core records account-linked act: WP XP Core records account-linked activity, XP, task submissions and achievement snapshots, plus private notification preferences/read state. Public standings show participating accounts. Administrators can export personal experience data through WordPress privacy tools. Deactivation, updates and deletion of plugin files retain the ledger, balances and settings. No automatic expiry or personal-data eraser is provided: deleting append-only records without a reviewed accounting and identity policy could break balances and audit evidence. Site administrators determine legal retention and respond to erasure requests using their site policy.
Independent experience and levels with c: Independent experience and levels with configurable activity rewards, private growth and achievements.
一项成就已撤销，详情可查看个人经验记录。: An achievement was revoked. See your private XP history for details.
不重算或补发历史经验。0 经验仍记录事件，避免日后重复领取；评论撤销与恢复使用首: No historical recalculation or backfill. Zero-XP events remain recorded to prevent duplicate claims. Comment reversals and restorations use the original actual amount.

以下范围用于阅读、文章、评论与作者里程碑。两项都留空表示全部；填写后，只要内容: These scopes apply to reading, posts, comments and author milestones. Leave both empty for all eligible content; otherwise either content or category may match. Permissions remain required.

Conditions, periods, dates, prerequisites, rewards or activation changes create a new version starting with subsequent activity. Earned snapshots stay unchanged. Weeks start Monday; months start on the first.

只包含规则、成长与任务。不会导出账号、通知、审计、余额、账本或存储配置。导入保留: Only rules, growth settings and tasks are included. Accounts, notifications, audits, balances, ledger and storage configuration are excluded. Import preserves unlisted tasks and history. Preview before applying; review content and image IDs when moving across sites.
只处理服务端已记录的首次奖励或评论状态补偿失败，并重新检查原事件和当前状态；不会: Only captured first-reward and comment-compensation failures can be retried. The original owner and current state are checked again, without history scans. Insufficient comment compensation is never partial; fund the balance before a reasoned retry. At most 200 failures are retained, not a permanent log.
只汇总有可靠事件快照的授予与撤销，不补造旧版本参与分母。耗时从任务版本定义创建开: Only reliable grant and revocation snapshots are counted; old participant denominators are not invented. Duration starts at task-version creation and includes waiting and inactivity. Old records without this evidence have no duration.

在事件账本中查找“完成任务”或“人工授予成就”的事件编号。撤销会扣回原经验，余额: Find the task completion or manual achievement event ID in the ledger. Revocation deducts the original actual XP; insufficient balance rejects the whole operation. A revoked version and period cannot be granted again.

奖励为 0 的有效活动也计入事件和参与人数。总参与人数已跨来源去重，不能把每行人: Eligible zero-XP activity still counts as events and participation. Total participants are deduplicated across sources, so row counts cannot be added. Task rewards and revocations count as activity; manual grants and their reversals are separate and excluded from public standings. Imports, reconciliation and management receipts are excluded here.
奖励为 0–1000000 的整数，每日次数为 0–1000。等级门槛最高为 1: Rewards are integers from 0 to 1000000; daily counts from 0 to 1000. Level thresholds allow up to 1000000000.

操作需要填写原因并检查目标用户权限。人工授予可确认自动步骤以外的完成依据，仍需满: A reason and target-user permissions are required. Manual grants may accept evidence beyond automatic steps, but still require task dates and prerequisites. Manual XP is excluded from public standings.

请选择用户并填写非零整数经验，单次最多 1000000。: Choose a user and a nonzero integer XP change, up to 1000000 per action.
输入用户编号查看详情，或按用户名查找。: Enter a user ID or search by username.

这项操作已经记录，没有再次发放。: This action was already recorded; no additional reward was issued.
连续签到断开后重新累计，不扣除已获得经验。每档奖励在这一版规则下只领取一次。: A missed check-in restarts the consecutive count without reclaiming XP. Each stage is claimable once in this rule generation.
适用内容与每日统计时区: Eligible content and daily statistics time zone
选择后，顶栏“经验签到”和登录返回链接会指向此页。请先按上方步骤加入短代码；保存: The top-bar check-in and login return links will point here. Add the shortcode first; saving never creates or publishes a page.
逐级设置最低经验，当前共: Set minimum XP for each level. Current count:
逐页读取现有记录并比较，不修改经验。差异需要先查清原因。: Read existing records page by page and compare without changing XP. Investigate differences before taking action.
通知暂时无法读取，请重试。: Notifications are temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
通知设置已更新，请重新读取后操作。: Notification settings changed. Refresh before acting.
通知设置未能保存，请重试。: Could not save notification settings. Please retry.
配置大小或导入方式无效。: Invalid configuration size or import mode.
配置未能应用，请重新预览。: Could not apply configuration. Preview again.
配置超过任务或导入映射上限。: Configuration exceeds task or import-mapping limits.
里程碑标识重复、无效或已经停用。: Duplicate, invalid or retired milestone ID.
阅读三篇不同的公开内容。: Read three different public content items.
面板设置已更新，请刷新页面。: Panel settings changed. Refresh the page.
面板设置未能保存，请重试。: Could not save panel settings. Please retry.
面板设置正被修改，请重试。: Panel settings are being modified. Please retry.
首级固定为 0，门槛须严格递增，最多 100 级。修改门槛会立即影响等级展示，不: The first threshold is fixed at 0; values must increase strictly, up to 100 levels. Threshold edits immediately affect level display without changing XP balances.
验证已过期，请刷新设置页。: Verification expired. Refresh the settings page.
默认 Asia/Shanghai。已有经验记录后不能修改，以免同一天重复领取奖励: Default: Asia/Shanghai. The time zone cannot change after XP is recorded, to avoid duplicate daily claims.
默认关闭。仅检查 wzf2000/wp-xp-core 官方安装 ZIP；稳定渠: Disabled by default. Checks only official installation ZIPs from wzf2000/wp-xp-core. Stable ignores prereleases; the prerelease channel also accepts newer stable releases. Never downgrades or adds scheduled tasks. Cache lasts up to six hours.
，发布后即可公开展示。可用: , then publish to display publicly. Use

手动读取最新五十条和五百条编号，显示查询数及本机耗时；样本不是整站或生产压测。: Manually read the newest 50 and 500 IDs, reporting query count and local elapsed time. This sample is not a site-wide or production load test.
提交完成说明，由管理员审核。: Submit a completion statement for administrator review.
暂停状态已更新，请重新读取。: The reward hold has changed. Reload its state.
暂停状态未能保存，请重试。: The reward hold could not be saved. Try again.
最近二十项，只记录对象和错误码；请核对原事件后使用服务端撤销接口处理，不自动重放: The latest 20 object IDs and error codes are retained. Inspect the original event and use the server reversal API; no automatic replay occurs.
最长二十四小时。有效活动和任务荣誉仍记录，期间自动经验为零，解除后不补差；人工调: Up to 24 hours. Valid activity and task honors still count, with zero automatic XP and no later backfill. Manual adjustments and exact reversals remain available.
本周在两篇不同公开内容下发表评论。: Comment on two different public items this week.
活动撤销未能记录，请重试。: The activity reversal could not be recorded. Try again.
活动记录不存在。: The activity receipt does not exist.
经验余额不足，未执行部分撤销。: Insufficient XP balance. No partial reversal was made.
自动经验奖励暂时为零，有效活动和任务荣誉仍记录；恢复后不补差。: Automatic XP rewards are temporarily zero. Valid activity and task honors still count; there is no later backfill.
请填写用户、原因和不超过二十四小时的暂停时间。: Enter a user, reason and hold duration of at most 24 hours.
阅读五篇不同内容，并在三个自然日签到。: Read five different items and check in on three calendar days.
预览通过，尚未保存。修改奖励或条件将建立新版本；新任务在保存后才累计活动，不重算: Preview passed; nothing has been saved. Reward or condition changes create a new version. New tasks count only activity after saving, without recalculating history.
新建任务，从保存后的活动累计。: New task; counts activity after saving.
将建立新版本，并从后续活动累计。: Creates a new version counting subsequent activity.
保留当前版本和进度。: Keeps the current version and progress.
